# The components

<!-- Generated by `npm run ui:readme` from src/showcase/manifest.ts and lang/en/ui_kit.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every screen of an admin built on the kit is made of the components in this folder and nothing else. **Before writing markup, find the component here**, or open the host's UI Kit screen (the showcase, `KitPage`) to see it live with the snippet to copy and the props, slots and events. **No component fits? Add one to the kit** with its entry in `src/showcase/manifest.ts`, its words in `lang/*/ui_kit.json` and its demo, not styles on the page. Tailwind classes on a page lay the kit out (grid, gap, width, margin); they never draw an element (a button, a field, a badge, a table) of their own.

The source of this file is the manifest (names, types, defaults, snippets) and `lang/en/ui_kit.json` (what each component is for and when to reach for it). `tests/ui/manifest.spec.ts` keeps the folder, the manifest, the words and this file in step.

## General elements

The controls of a form. A control with a `label` is the whole field; a bare control sits in a UiFormField of the page or in a toolbar and takes its ids from there.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiInput` | A single-line text control: text, email, phone, number, date, search. | Any one-line value the user types. Give it a `label` and it is the whole field with hint and error; leave the label off inside a UiFormField or a toolbar. |
| `UiPasswordInput` | A password control with the eye that reveals it and, on request, a judgement of its strength. | Every password field: sign-in, the profile, the link that sets a password. Turn `strength` on where a new password is typed; the only rule the application enforces is `minLength`, the other checks only add to the word. |
| `UiCopyField` | A value to hand over, not to edit, with the button that copies it. | A link the office sends by hand, a key, an id someone will paste elsewhere. The field is read only and selects itself on focus; where the browser refuses the clipboard the value is selected for a manual copy. |
| `UiTextarea` | A multi-line text control. | Notes, comments, addresses of more than one line. Same field behaviour as UiInput. |
| `UiPlaceInput` | An address search with Google Places suggestions that fills street, city, state and zip. | An address in a form: the person types, picks a suggestion and the form fields fill in, still theirs to correct. Without a Maps key it is a plain text box and the fields are typed by hand. |
| `UiRichTextEditor` | Rich text with bold, italic, underline and two colours, as HTML. | A message whose look matters to the reader, as a note shown to the team on a record. The server cleans the HTML; the editor only offers the marks it keeps. |
| `UiFileInput` | A control that picks one file from the device. | An upload in a form: a table to import, a document. The file goes up with the form; the server checks its type and size. |
| `UiSelect` | A native select over a fixed, short list of options. | One choice out of a known list (status, team, plan). Up to a few dozen options; a search over many records is a UiSearchInput with its own results. |
| `UiMultiSelect` | Several choices out of a list, in a dropdown with a checkbox per option. | A filter that takes any number of values (owners, tags, teams): it holds its place in a UiFilterBar like a UiSelect. A handful of flags saved with a form is a UiCheckboxGroup. |
| `UiChipGroup` | One choice out of a row of chips that all show at once. | A pick that the reader makes by eye from a dozen or two short names, as the request guide picks a type, a problem and a brand. Picking the chosen chip again clears it. A few options with descriptions are a UiRadioGroup; a long list is a UiSelect. |
| `UiCheckbox` | One yes/no choice with its own label. | A flag that is saved with the form (primary contact, accept the terms). For a setting that applies at once use UiSwitch. |
| `UiCheckboxGroup` | Several yes/no choices under one caption, saved as the list of picked values. | The roles of a user, the permissions of a role, the days of a schedule: a set of flags that is one field of the form, with one error. |
| `UiSwitch` | An on/off setting. | A setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped (auto-renewal, notifications). Where a Save button follows, use UiCheckbox. |
| `UiRadioGroup` | One choice out of a few that all fit on screen. | Two to five options the reader should see at once (how to send: email, SMS, by hand). A longer list is a UiSelect. |
| `UiFormField` | Label, help text and error around a control, with the ids wired. | A field with more than one control (street and city), a custom control, or a bare UiInput the page wants its own layout for. A control given a `label` makes one of these by itself. |
| `UiLabel` | The caption of a control. | Only when building a custom field by hand; UiFormField and the controls render it for you. |
| `UiHelpText` | A line under a control that explains it. | Only when building a custom field by hand; otherwise the `hint` prop. |
| `UiFieldError` | The validation message of one control. | Only when building a custom field by hand; otherwise the `error` prop. Renders nothing without a message. |
| `UiForm` | A form that stops the browser submit, disables its actions while the request runs and shows an error that belongs to no field. | Every form of a screen that the app posts. |

## Buttons

One primary action per screen, secondary ones beside it, danger for what cannot be undone. A button that navigates is a UiButton with `href`.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiButton` | An action, or a link that looks like one. | Every clickable action with a word on it. `primary` once per screen, `secondary` beside it, `danger` for what cannot be undone, `ghost` and `link` for quiet actions in a row of text. |
| `UiIconButton` | A square button with one icon and a label for assistive tech. | Row actions in a table, closing a dialog, toggles in a header. The `label` is what a screen reader says and the tooltip shows; never leave it generic. |

## Data

Lists and figures: the table of a screen, the search and the filters over it, the badge of a state, the number in a card or a chip.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiTable` | The list of a screen: columns, rows, a slot per cell, sorting, an empty state, a loading state. | Any list of records. With `sort` bound the parent orders the rows (the server, usually); without it the table orders what it was given. |
| `UiSearchInput` | A search box that searches once typing pauses. | The free-text search over a list or a lookup of records. The value is bound at once; `search` fires after the pause or on Enter. |
| `UiCombobox` | A search box with a list of options under it to pick from with the pointer or the keyboard. | A lookup of records while typing that ends in picking one (a person by name, phone or email), with rows of its own such as "Create". The free-text search over a list on screen is a UiSearchInput. |
| `UiFilterBar` | The row of filters over a list with the Show and Reset buttons. | A list with two or more filters. The controls go in the slot; the page handles `apply` and `reset`. |
| `UiBadge` | A short status word in a tone. | The state of a record in a list or a card (active, failed, draft). `dot` draws the state as a point before the word. |
| `UiDescriptionList` | A caption and a value per line: the "Information" block of a card. | The card of one record (a user, a project, a role). A value that is not plain text (a badge, a list, a link) goes in the slot of its key. |
| `UiText` | A run of secondary text: a note, the placeholder of an empty value, a name from the code. | Wherever a page would otherwise colour a span itself: "no roles" in a cell, "never" for a date, a permission name in monospace, a line of explanation that belongs to no control (that one is UiHelpText). |
| `UiAvatar` | The initials of a person in a circle, or their picture. | A person in a header, a menu or a list. |
| `UiStatCard` | One figure with its name: a card on a dashboard, or a chip in the header. | A count or a sum the reader watches (tasks today, active members). With `href` it opens the list behind the figure; `compact` makes the chip of the header. |
| `UiBarChart` | Stacked bars: a column per day of a month, or a line per item with its total on the right. | How a count splits over days or over groups (tasks done and overdue by day, tasks by team). A single figure is a UiStatCard; exact numbers to compare row by row are a UiTable. |
| `UiStreetView` | A picture of an address: Google Street View, or a map with a pin where there is no panorama. | Beside an address in a form or a card, so the reader sees the building. It shows nothing without a Maps key or when Google refuses the pictures; it is never needed to fill a form. |
| `UiMap` | A Google Maps canvas with polygons on it, painted and culled by the parent. | A screen that shows or edits areas on a map. The parent passes the polygons to keep on the map and a style per polygon, and listens to clicks, the pointer and the viewport. Give it a height with a layout class. |
| `UiRichText` | Text with marks that the server has cleaned, shown as it was written. | Showing a rich text saved by UiRichTextEditor, such as a note for the team. Never HTML that did not pass the server. |
| `UiCodeBlock` | Preformatted text or data as the machine wrote it, with a copy button. | A payload of a provider event, the extra data of a session, a raw request: something read by a developer or support, not by an operator. Data a person reads is a UiDescriptionList. |
| `UiAudioPlayer` | The browser's own player of a sound file: play, pause, the time line and the volume. | A recording on a card. The page gives the file's address when it has one (a link asked at the moment of listening); nothing loads before the person presses play. `play` tells the page a play started, so it can renew a link that ran out; the exposed `element` starts, seeks and stops it. |
| `UiSwatch` | A small square of a color, with the word it stands for. | The color of a record that is drawn in that color elsewhere (an area on the map), or a key of a map legend. A state of a record is a UiBadge, not a swatch. |
| `UiEmbedFrame` | A page of another service inside ours, put in by that service's own embed.js and grown to its height. | A page of another service shown inside a screen of ours. Give it only an address the backend handed over at the moment the person asked (a short-lived ticket), never one built on the page; it loads `<origin>/embed.js` once, says loading and a failure in words, and removes the frame when it goes. An address that is not http(s) is a failure at once. |

## Feedback

What the app tells the reader: a message that stays, a notice that passes, a dialog that asks, a placeholder while loading, an empty list.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiAlert` | A message that stays on the page. | Something the reader should know while on this screen: a limit, a refusal, a warning about test mode. For the result of an action that just happened, raise a toast. |
| `UiToaster` | The corner where toasts appear; raised from code with useToast(). | The result of an action that just happened (saved, sent, failed). The layout mounts one UiToaster and turns the flash of every response into toasts; a page raises its own with useToast(). |
| `UiModal` | A dialog over the page with the focus trapped inside. | A short form or a detail that does not deserve its own screen (add a contact, pick an address). Escape and the backdrop ask to close; the parent owns `open`. |
| `UiDrawer` | A panel that slides in from the right over the page, with the focus trapped inside. | The detail of a row the reader opens without leaving the list (an event from a log, a task from a board). A form that stands on its own is a UiModal; a record with tabs and history is its own screen. |
| `UiConfirmDialog` | "Are you sure?" with one action. | Before anything that cannot be undone (merge, cancel, refund). The parent runs the action on `confirm` and closes the dialog when it is done. |
| `UiSpinner` | Something is loading. | Inside a button, a search box or a chip while a request runs. For a whole block that loads, prefer UiSkeleton. |
| `UiSkeleton` | A grey placeholder in the shape of what is loading. | Lines of text, a block or a circle while the data is on its way, so the layout does not jump. |
| `UiEmptyState` | What a list says when there is nothing in it. | An empty table, card or screen: the name of what is missing, a line about it, and the one thing to do. |
| `UiTooltip` | A short hint over an element, on hover and on focus. | An icon button or a truncated value that needs a word; never the only way to learn something essential. |

## Navigation

Moving around a screen: tabs over one record, a menu of actions, pages of a list, the title and the crumbs at the top.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiTabs` | Tabs over the data of one screen. | Sections of one record (contacts, addresses, history). Navigation between screens is the sidebar, not tabs. |
| `UiTabPanel` (with `UiTabs`) | The content of one tab. | Inside UiTabs, one per tab, with the tab's `value`. |
| `UiTabNav` | The tabs of one record when each tab has its own address: links with an icon and a figure. | A record worked on in sections that each open by URL, as a project with Overview, Tasks and Files. A column beside the record on a wide screen, a scrolling row on a narrow one. Tabs within one screen are UiTabs. |
| `UiDropdown` | A menu under a trigger with keyboard navigation. | Several actions behind one button (row actions, the account menu). The trigger is one element in the `trigger` slot; the items are UiDropdownItem. |
| `UiDropdownItem` (with `UiDropdown`) | One line of a menu: a link or an action. | Inside UiDropdown. With `href` it navigates; otherwise it emits `select`. |
| `UiDropdownSeparator` (with `UiDropdown`) | A line between groups of menu items. | Inside UiDropdown, between unrelated items (the way out below the rest). |
| `UiPagination` | The pages of a list, with the first, the last and the neighbours of the current one. | Under a UiTable whose rows come one page at a time. The parent fetches the page it is asked for. |
| `UiPageHeader` | The top of a screen: crumbs, title, a line under it, the actions on the right. | First element of every page. The layout persists, so the header belongs to the page. |
| `UiBreadcrumbs` | Where the reader is: every crumb but the last is a link. | Inside UiPageHeader through its `breadcrumbs` prop; on its own only where there is no header. |
| `UiChip` | A small rounded label the reader can pick. | Sections of a page, filter tokens, anchors further down the screen. The active one is marked; with `href` it navigates, without it emits `select`. |
| `UiKbd` | A key of the keyboard. | A hint about a shortcut (Esc to close, / to search). |

## Layout

The surfaces and lines a page is laid out with, and the tokens behind every color and radius of the kit.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiDisclosure` | A block that opens and closes under its own title. | A secondary table or detail the reader opens when needed, as a "Done by day" table under a report. Closed by default; a block that is always needed is a UiCard. |
| `UiCard` | A bordered surface with an optional heading row and footer. | A block of a screen with its own title (contacts, addresses, a form). `padding="none"` lets a UiTable fill it edge to edge. |
| `UiList` | Rows with a line between them. | A short list of things with an action on each (the ways to sign in, the permissions of a group); the rows are UiListItem. A list of records with columns is a UiTable. |
| `UiListItem` (with `UiList`) | One row of a UiList. | Inside UiList: a title with a line under it, an icon before it, the badge or the button after it. |
| `UiDivider` | A line between two parts, or a word in the middle of one. | Between sections of a form, between items of a toolbar (`vertical`), or "or" between two ways to sign in. |
| `UiAppShell` | The frame of every signed-in screen: the dark sidebar with the brand, the menu and a footer, and the page beside it. | Once, in the layout of the signed-in screens. On a phone the sidebar becomes a drawer behind a menu button in a top bar; it closes when the path changes, and `closeMenu` of the footer slot closes it before an item opens a dialog. |
| `UiNavItem` (with `UiAppShell`) | One line of the dark sidebar: a screen to open or an action. | Inside the `nav` or `footer` slot of UiAppShell. With `href` it is the app's link and marks itself current while the path is `activePrefix` or under it; without `href` it is a button that emits `click`. |
| `UiSidebarIdentity` (with `UiAppShell`) | Who is signed in, at the foot of the dark sidebar: the name and a caption under it. | In the `footer` slot of UiAppShell, above the language and sign out. |
| `UiSidebarSelect` (with `UiAppShell`) | A small native select drawn for the dark sidebar. | A short choice in the sidebar, such as the language. On a light surface it is a UiSelect. |
| `UiAuthFrame` | The frame of the pages a guest sees: the product's name and one card in the middle. | Sign in, a link that ran out, a page that cannot be reached without an account. Everything else is inside UiAppShell. |

## Softphone

The parts of a softphone in the manner of Click's dock: the dark bar along the bottom of the page, its panels, the collapsed button, the keypad and the icons it draws by Click's names.

| Component | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `UiIcon` | A Material Design icon by the name Click gives it (`phone`, `phone-hangup`, `dialpad`), drawn from its SVG path alone. | In the softphone and wherever a screen must show the same glyph as Click; elsewhere the kit draws lucide icons. It takes the size and the colour of the text around it. |
| `UiDock` | The softphone's frame, Click's VoiceDockBar: a dark bar 44 pixels high along the bottom of the page and, above its right end, the one panel open at a time. | Once, in the `dock` slot of UiAppShell. The bar publishes the band it takes as `--voice-dock-height` on the root element (0 while collapsed), which the shell keeps free; `inline` puts it in the flow of an embedded page instead. |
| `UiDockButton` (with `UiDock`) | A button of the softphone, Click's `.btn` of the dock. | `ghost` on the dark bar, `light` on a white panel, `green` to call or answer, `red` to hang up or reject. With `href` it is a link that looks the same (a `tel:` link). |
| `UiDockChip` (with `UiDock`) | A pill of the dock, Click's `.chip`: the agent's status with its coloured point, the missed call to ring back, the second line. | On the bar. A chip that holds buttons of its own (the second line's Answer and Decline) is `inert`. |
| `UiDockDialog` (with `UiDock`) | A question over the page and the softphone's bar, Click's CallMethodDialog: a title, its hint and the answers in a column. | A choice the dock asks before it acts: how to call a number. Escape and a click on the shade cancel; the focus starts on the control marked `data-autofocus`. |
| `UiDockFab` (with `UiDock`) | The collapsed softphone, Click's `.voice-dock-fab`: a round button at the right edge with the call's timer or an icon and the status point at its corner. | In the `fab` slot of UiDock. It moves by the pointer and the arrow keys and snaps to the right edge, anchored to the nearer vertical edge; the host keeps the anchor (`parseFabAnchor`, `serializeFabAnchor`). |
| `UiDockInput` (with `UiDock`) | The number field of the softphone, Click's `.quick-input` on the bar or, `wide`, its `.dial-input` across a panel. | Where the agent types a number to call. Enter dials. |
| `UiDockText` (with `UiDock`) | A word on the dock or in its panel, in one of its kinds. | `caller` who the call is with, `error` what failed, `timer` the length of the call, `empty` a list with nothing in it yet, `meta` the small grey line beside a row, `fab` the timer on the collapsed button. |
| `UiDockSpacer` (with `UiDock`) | Between the dock's groups: a thin line or the room that pushes what follows to the right. | On the bar, between groups of chips and buttons. |
| `UiDockPlainButton` (with `UiDock`) | A bare icon button of the softphone, Click's `.plain`: no background or border, the colour of the text around it. | A small action in a panel's title or on the bar: settings, collapse, close. |
| `UiDockTicker` (with `UiDock`) | Click's live transcript line above the softphone's bar: who said the last line and the line, cut to one row. | In the `ticker` slot of UiDock while a call is transcribed. |
| `UiDockPanel` (with `UiDock`) | A white card over the dock's right end, Click's `.voice-dock-panel`: a title, its buttons and a cross, then the content. | In the `panel` slot of UiDock: the history, the colleagues, the queues, the transfer, the keypad. |
| `UiDockTabs` (with `UiDock`) | The tabs of the softphone's panel, Click's `.panel-tabs`: one segmented row. | Over the lists of a panel. A tab's `badge` above zero shows beside its label in amber (the calls waiting in the agent's queues). |
| `UiDockRow` (with `UiDock`) | A line of the softphone's history, Click's `.vd-row`: the direction's icon in its colour, who, when, and the round green button that calls back. | In the history list of a panel. |
| `UiDockPerson` (with `UiDock`) | A colleague in the softphone's panel: the point that says whether their softphone is there, the name, the extension and status, and the button that calls them. | In the colleagues list of a panel. |
| `UiDockLine` (with `UiDock`) | A line of the softphone's panel, Click's `.vd-row` of the Queues tab: a point, the label, the small grey meta and the line's action. | A list in a panel that is neither the history nor the colleagues: the agent's queues. |
| `UiDockTarget` (with `UiDock`) | A colleague the call can go to, Click's `.vd-row` of the Transfer panel: the green point, the name, and the buttons. | In the transfer panel, one line per colleague who can take the call. |
| `UiDockStatus` (with `UiDock`) | How an action of the softphone goes, Click's `.transfer-status`: a turning circle, a tick or a warning, read out as it changes. | Under the panel that started the action: a transfer, a participant added. |
| `UiDockSettings` (with `UiDock`) | The softphone's settings under the panel's title, Click's `.audio-settings`: a bordered column of fields and buttons. | The devices and the like, opened from a button of the panel's title. |
| `UiDockSelect` (with `UiDock`) | A choice in the softphone's settings: the label above a full-width native select. | In UiDockSettings: the microphone, the speaker. |
| `UiDockTextarea` (with `UiDock`) | A few lines of text in a panel of the softphone, Click's `.note-area`. | The call's note. |
| `UiDialpad` | The phone's twelve keys, Click's DIALPAD. | In a panel of the softphone: to type a number, or to send tones during a call. `letters` prints the letters under the digits. |

## Words

The words a component needs by itself (close, previous, loading) are in `lang/*/ui.json`, under the `ui.` keys; the words of a screen are the host's. A component never holds a literal.
